name: Heiterwangsee
kurzbeschreibung: The **türkisfarbene** Heiterwangsee by the Fernpass is a picturesque lakeside spot for swimming, offering stunning views of the Zugspitze.
beschreibung: Heiterwangsee – Nestled in the breathtaking Tyrolean mountain landscape, **Heiterwangsee** offers an unforgettable natural experience. This turquoise **Heiterwangsee** by the Fernpass is an idyllic lakeside spot with stunning views of the Zugspitze. The unique scenery, with its rugged rock formations, crystal-clear mountain streams, and fragrant alpine meadows, draws nature lovers from around the world. A visit in the early morning or at dusk rewards you with especially atmospheric lighting. Just a few kilometers from **Heiterwang**, the **Heiterwangsee** awaits with a piece of untouched nature to be explored. The location also offers a magnificent panoramic view of the surrounding mountain ranges. Families with children will also find plenty to discover and enjoy here. A visit to **Heiterwangsee** is worthwhile year-round and is guaranteed to leave a lasting impression.
